regime_context: The policy regime is a sequenced, optionality-based campaign: the Fed (Warsh) banks hawkish credibility now while Treasury (Bessent) suppresses the front end structurally, and easing stays inflation-gated optionality post-midterm. The consensus narrative treats this as a coordinated low-real-yield deal, but revealed preference says it is aligned incentives with a hard inflation-mandate first constraint — the market is roughly aligned with the Fed on end-2026 rates, so the tradable edge is in the stagflationary split and the re-primed energy/defense rotation, not in front-running cuts.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制是一场按顺序推进、以期权思维构建的行动：美联储（沃什）当前积累鹰派信誉，财政部（贝森特）在结构上压低短端收益率，而宽松仍以通胀为门槛、作为中期选举后的期权保留。市场共识把它当成一个协调的低实际收益率安排，但显示性偏好说明这只是激励对齐、且硬约束是通胀目标优先——市场对2026年底利率的定价与美联储基本一致，因此可交易的边际在滞胀裂口和被重新点燃的能源/国防轮动，而不是抢先押注降息。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse is a realized upside oil shock, and energy was already the top ETF-inflow sector on the conflict; the administration's re-escalation posture keeps the supply-risk bid primed even as it would prefer lower headline inflation. That makes XLE the cleanest expression of the stagflationary split relative to a broad SPY that carries rate-sensitive and consumer exposure.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂是已经兑现的油价上行冲击，而能源本就是冲突背景下ETF流入最多的板块；政府重新升级的态势令供给风险溢价持续存在，尽管政府更希望压低整体通胀。相对于包含利率敏感型和消费敞口的SPY，XLE是表达滞胀裂口最直接的标的。
evidence: Iran / Middle East theater: ceasefire COLLAPSED as of 7/8, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday 7/8
Energy was the TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 (first in years) on the conflict
Re-escalation posture keeps the rotation re-primed; watch Hormuz transit data
theses.dissent: A genuine ceasefire or de-escalation headline would unwind the spike risk premium fast, and the administration's own preference for lower headline inflation could lead it to restrain escalation precisely because oil feeds the very inflation Warsh is fighting.
theses.dissent_zh: 真正的停火或降级消息会迅速消退飙升风险溢价，而且政府自身希望压低整体通胀，可能恰恰因为油价会加剧沃什所对抗的通胀而选择克制升级。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by more than 5% over the holding window despite no ceasefire.
falsifier.text_zh: 在没有停火的情况下，XLE在持有窗口内仍落后SPY超过5%。

theses.subject: ITA
theses.thesis: Defense is a structural NATO spending super-cycle independent of the oil headline, and the Iran re-escalation adds near-term pressure for munitions and missile defense. The prior ITA call missed, so conviction stays low, but the policy driver is persistent and the two-sided risk is headline-driven rather than fundamental.
theses.thesis_zh: 国防是独立于油价头条的北约结构性支出超级周期，而伊朗重新升级给弹药和导弹防御增加了近期压力。此前ITA的判断曾失误，因此信心保持低位，但政策驱动持续存在，双向风险主要来自头条而非基本面。
evidence: NATO / Defense theater: structural spending super-cycle, high-confidence
Defense bid persists regardless of oil; proxies ITA, XAR, PPA, SHLD
theses.dissent: The prior ITA overweight missed (-10.4% realized), and if the defense bid is already priced after the Q1 rotation, XAR or PPA could lead while ITA lags on composition effects.
theses.dissent_zh: 此前ITA超配判断失误（实际-10.4%），而如果国防买盘在Q1轮动后已被定价，XAR或PPA可能领涨，ITA则因成分结构而落后。

falsifier.text: ITA lags SPY by more than 5% over the holding window despite continued escalation headlines.
falsifier.text_zh: 在升级头条持续的情况下，ITA在持有窗口内仍落后SPY超过5%。

check.note: graded via correlated surrogate XLI (no local series for ITA)

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: With the market now pricing a majority probability of a September hike and Warsh holding the hawkish line even after the labor crack, long-duration Treasuries face a stagflationary squeeze: hot inflation blocks the easing path while the recent TLT underweight already hit. The front-end yield suppression benefits BIL/SHV, not the long end, so TLT is the vulnerable leg.
theses.thesis_zh: 市场目前对9月加息的定价概率超过半数，而沃什即使在就业裂口出现后仍维持鹰派，长端美债面临滞胀挤压：高通胀封堵宽松路径，而此前TLT低配判断已经命中。短端收益率抑制利好BIL/SHV而非长端，因此TLT是脆弱的一环。
evidence: CME FedWatch >70% probability of a Sept hike (50.6% 25bp + 19.6% 50bp)
Warsh's Sintra response held the hawkish line; declined to signal July
Prior TLT underweight hit (-7.2% realized); front-end Treasuries are the policy beneficiary
theses.dissent: A labor-crack widening into a September data-driven pivot would reopen the easing path and rally the long end sharply, and the Fed path gap is only -10bp, meaning the market has not priced much hawkishness at the end-2026 horizon.
theses.dissent_zh: 若就业裂口扩大到9月出现数据驱动的政策转向，将重新打开宽松路径并使长端大幅反弹，而且美联储路径差仅-10个基点，意味着市场并未在2026年底期限上定价多少鹰派预期。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by more than 3% over the holding window without a September cut being priced.
falsifier.text_zh: 在没有9月降息被定价的情况下，TLT在持有窗口内跑赢SPY超过3%。

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The advanced-chip tariff and the Section 301 replacement handoff keep the domestic semiconductor onshoring premium intact, and the prior SMH overweight hit. The de-risking mandate funds domestic chip capacity even under a China truce, so the policy tailwind is structural rather than headline-dependent as long as the tariff handoff completes.
theses.thesis_zh: 先进芯片关税和301条款替代方案的交接使国内半导体回岸溢价得以维持，此前SMH超配判断已经命中。去风险指令即使在贸易休战下仍为国内芯片产能提供资金，因此只要关税交接完成，政策顺风是结构性的而非依赖头条。
evidence: China tech war theater: the SCOTUS strike-down did NOT unwind the tariff-protection premium
Section 301 replacement (~12.5%) pending after Section 122 expires July 24
theses.dissent: If the Section 301 handoff stalls or the effective China tariff rate falls materially after July 24, the onshoring premium could unwind, and SMH carries AI-valuation beta that is vulnerable to any hawkish repricing.
theses.dissent_zh: 若301条款交接停滞或7月24日后对华实际关税率大幅下降，回岸溢价可能消退，而SMH带有AI估值贝塔，对任何鹰派重定价都很脆弱。

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by more than 5% over the holding window despite the Section 301 replacement staying in force.
falsifier.text_zh: 在301条款替代方案仍生效的情况下，SMH在持有窗口内仍落后SPY超过5%。

theses.subject: KBE
theses.thesis: The dealer-intermediation reform and eSLR progress are structural tailwinds for the banking system, but the prior KBE overweight missed and the current hike-majority tape leaves the deposit-cost and loan-loss channels offsetting any regulatory relief. Until there is concrete eSLR rule progress or a confirmed hold-to-ease turn, KBE lacks a clean policy edge versus SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: 交易商中介改革和eSLR进展对银行体系是结构性利好，但此前KBE超配判断失误，而当前加息占多数的市场环境下存款成本和贷款损失渠道会抵消监管松绑的利好。在出现具体的eSLR规则进展或确认由按兵不动转向宽松之前，KBE相对SPY缺乏清晰的政策优势。
evidence: Open prediction: concrete eSLR-reform progress (proposed or final rule) — still pending
Hike-majority tape (>70% Sept hike probability) pressures deposit betas and credit
theses.dissent: If eSLR reform lands as a final rule and the Fed pivots data-driven toward easing after the labor crack, bank equities would be a first-order beneficiary and KBE could decisively outperform SPY.
theses.dissent_zh: 若eSLR改革以最终规则落地，且美联储在就业裂口后转向数据驱动的宽松，银行股将是首要受益者，KBE可能明显跑赢SPY。

falsifier.text: KBE outperforms SPY by more than 5% over the holding window without a concrete eSLR rule or Fed pivot.
falsifier.text_zh: 在没有具体eSLR规则或美联储转向的情况下，KBE在持有窗口内跑赢SPY超过5%。
